description: Add an email address to the account's suppression list, so Mailtrap stops delivering to it.

domain_id.description: ID of the sending domain the suppression applies to, as returned by the Sending Domains tools.

sending_stream.description: Sending stream to suppress the address for.

type.description: Reason recorded for the suppression. Defaults to `manual import` when omitted.

name: create-suppression
